checked.found: 1219 is the traditional date of the Battle of Lyndanisse legend; the description says 'was said to', so it frames the story as legend. The name 'Dannebrog Falls From the Sky' is the legend's title but is stated flatly; consider 'The Dannebrog Legend' if Edward wants it clearer.
James I decreed the first Union Flag for ships in April 1606.
First recorded raising aboard USS Alfred, December 1775 (Prospect Hill on 1 January 1776 is traditional but disputed). 1775 is the better-documented year.
Flag Resolution of 14 June 1777.
Decree of 15 February 1794 fixed the vertical blue-white-red tricolour.
Cispadane Republic adopted the green-white-red flag on 7 January 1797.
Act of Union took effect 1 January 1801 and added St Patrick's saltire.
Belgrano raised the flag at Rosario on the Paraná, 27 February 1812; the Triumvirate disapproved.
Adopted by the First National Assembly at Epidaurus, 1 January 1822 (old style); nine stripes tied to the nine syllables of 'Eleftheria i Thanatos'.
Thomas Francis Meagher presented the tricolour in Waterford in March 1848 after returning from France.
Year 1870 is right (Proclamation No. 57, 27 February 1870, merchant ships). But 'Rising Sun Flag' is a different flag (Kyokujitsu-ki, with rays); the plain red disc is the Hinomaru.
Flag decreed 19 November 1889, four days after the republic was proclaimed.
Flag unfurled at Aguinaldo's house in Kawit on 12 June 1898, sewn in Hong Kong.
Flown over the Exhibition Building, Melbourne, 3 September 1901 after a public design competition.
King Vajiravudh adopted the tricolour (Trairanga) on 28 September 1917, replacing the white elephant flag.
Weimar Constitution of August 1919 set black-red-gold.
Hammer-and-sickle flag with gold-bordered red star adopted 12 November 1923 (the December 1922 flag carried the coat of arms). The year 1923 is right and the description matches.
Constituent Assembly adopted the flag 22 July 1947.
Provisional State Council adopted the flag 28 October 1948.
First raised in Tiananmen Square on 1 October 1949.
Raised at independence, 6 March 1957.
Current flag fixed by the constitution of 16 December 1962; the only non-rectangular national flag.
Raised on Parliament Hill 15 February 1965.

Flag first raised 2 December 1971 (year correct), but only six emirates formed the UAE then; Ras al-Khaimah joined in February 1972 (Britannica). 'Seven sheikhdoms' is wrong for 1971. Sources also say the rulers raised it together at Union House, so 'hoisted by the ruler of Abu Dhabi' was not confirmed.
checked.suggestion: Six sheikhdoms joined under a flag of pan-Arab red, green, white and black, raised at Union House in Dubai.

Raised at midnight 17-18 April 1980 at independence.
Tricolour hoisted/adopted 22 August 1991 after the failed August coup (de jure November 1991).
Flag first flown 27 April 1994, the day of the first all-race elections; 'just before' is loose but acceptable.
Flag unveiled 17 February 2008 with the declaration of independence; six stars for ethnic groups.
Raised at independence ceremony in Juba, 9 July 2011.
